items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Prince Conta at one time, he was there. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, he was playing there, just, just doing a single, see?

ctx.x: Well, anyway. That was, so, but the Fern was downstairs and that's where Armand, Hug was playing. Mm-hmm. What I was saying, on my animation, I used to go downstairs and, and listen to those guys, you know. And, uh, listen to the different guys. I, I used to, I like to go in and hear this guy, that guy, see? On my animation, or something like that. But that's when I first, uh, right, and then later on, when I come back down, down from, uh, Jimmy, he was playing at, uh, what was his name of that hotel? When? When?…
Prince Conta at one time, he was there.
Well, he was playing there, just, just doing a single, see? Oh, yeah. And, uh, that's, that's when, when we got together with Roger Wolfe Kahn, uh, Roger Wolfe Kahn. Roger Wolfe.
